steps.message:
Implement the one-way converter:

```csharp
using System.Globalization;

public sealed class OrderStatusToColorConverter : IValueConverter
{
    public object Convert(
        object? value,
        Type targetType,
        object? parameter,
        CultureInfo culture) =>
        value is OrderStatus status
            ? status switch
            {
                OrderStatus.Pending => Colors.Orange,
                OrderStatus.Shipped => Colors.DodgerBlue,
                OrderStatus.Delivered => Colors.Green,
                OrderStatus.Cancelled => Colors.Red,
                _ => Colors.Gray
            }
            : Colors.Gray;

    public object ConvertBack(
        object? value,
        Type targetType,
        object? parameter,
        CultureInfo culture) =>
        throw new NotSupportedException();
}
```

Register and consume it in XAML:

```xml
<ContentPage
    xmlns="http://schemas.microsoft.com/dotnet/2021/maui"
    xmlns:x="http://schemas.microsoft.com/winfx/2009/xaml"
    xmlns:local="clr-namespace:Orders">
    <ContentPage.Resources>
        <local:OrderStatusToColorConverter
            x:Key="OrderStatusToColor" />
    </ContentPage.Resources>

    <Label Text="{Binding Status}"
           TextColor="{Binding Status,
               Converter={StaticResource OrderStatusToColor}}" />
</ContentPage>
```

Every declared status has a color, and null, an unexpected enum value, or another input type safely falls back to Gray.
